title: How do I reset my device's network settings to fix persistent connectivity issues?
content:
Question: How do I reset my device's network settings to fix persistent connectivity issues?

Answer: On most Android/iOS devices, go to Settings > General/System > Reset > Reset Network Settings. This clears saved Wi-Fi/APN/Bluetooth configurations, so ensure you know your Wi-Fi passwords before proceeding. This is a common first troubleshooting step for both data and calling issues.

Topic: Technical Support & Troubleshooting
